intent: How many products are no longer sold?
description: products.discontinued = 1 flags items no longer available

intent: Which supplier provides the most products in our catalog?
description: Count products grouped by supplier_id, join to suppliers for name

intent: What is the average order value for each destination country?
description: order value = sum(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) grouped by orders.ship_country

intent: Which employee processed the most customer orders?
description: Count orders grouped by employee_id, join to employees for name

intent: What product category generates the most total revenue?
description: Sum revenue via order_details, group by products.category_id, join categories for name

intent: Which customers have never placed an order?
description: LEFT JOIN customers to orders on customer_id, filter where order_id IS NULL

intent: What is the total shipping cost collected by destination country?
description: Sum orders.freight grouped by orders.ship_country

intent: Which products are nearly out of stock?
description: Filter products where units_in_stock is very low (e.g. < 5)

intent: What is the total revenue generated by each sales employee?
description: Sum order_details revenue grouped by orders.employee_id, join employees for name

intent: Which country has the largest number of customers?
description: Count customers grouped by customers.country

intent: What is the best-selling product by total quantity ordered?
description: Sum order_details.quantity grouped by product_id, join products for name

intent: How many orders were placed each year?
description: Group orders by year extracted from orders.order_date

intent: Which products have never appeared in any order?
description: LEFT JOIN products to order_details on product_id, filter where order_id IS NULL

intent: What is the average discount percentage applied per product category?
description: Average order_details.discount grouped by products.category_id, join categories

intent: What is the total inventory value for each product category?
description: Sum unit_price * units_in_stock grouped by category_id, join categories

intent: What is the average product price offered by each supplier country?
description: Average products.unit_price grouped by suppliers.country via supplier_id

intent: Which employees were hired most recently?
description: Sort employees by hire_date descending to find most recently hired

intent: How many orders include at least one discounted item?
description: Count distinct order_id from order_details where discount > 0

intent: Which customer has spent the most money across all their orders?
description: Sum revenue grouped by customer_id, join customers for company_name

intent: What are the top five most expensive products still available for sale?
description: Filter products where discontinued = 0, sort by unit_price descending, limit 5
